newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Changhong to invest $277.1 mln in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China's Changhong to invest $277.1 mln in 1997.

text.p: China's Sichuan Changhong Electric Appliances Co plans to invest 2.3 billion yuan ($277.1 million) to expand production in 1997, a company official said on Tuesday.
Output of its televisions was expected to rise to eight million in three years from the current six million, the official said.

Sales of its televisions rose 255 percent in the first four months compared with the year-ago period, with total 1997 sales revenue estimated to reach 18 billion yuan, he said without giving comparative figures.

A video compact disc production line and an air conditioner line were under construction, with a designed production capacity of 400,000 discs and 500,000 air conditioners a year, he said by telephone from southwestern Sichuan province.
Changhong has said its sales hit $1.29 billion in 1996, making it China's top electronics firm in terms of turnover.
